pr_body:
Fixes #70810.

Hopefully it's all pretty straightforward.

Cc @dotnet/ilc-contrib 

@LakshanF @sbomer Vitek, Jan, Tlaka are all out. It's on you whether this can make it before 7.0 cutoff. No pressure.
pr_comments: I added support in the testing infra which didn't take too many changes, I'm able to parse the XML and keep some nodes, but reflectable fields/methods while getting dependencies don't have a way to detect if they are annotated with Requires so the whole purpose of testing the warnings doesn't work. Opened https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/73952

issue_context.title: Add support for ILLink.Descriptors.xml
issue_context.body: We need to parse the file format and root things from it.
comments: If we don't have a separate issue for it, let's keep this open - we also need to support `<TrimmerRootDescriptor Include="MyRoots.xml" />`

review_comments: OwningModule is nullable and handled. This throw was too eager.
